target_customer: Consumers who want one map of places, friends, plans and memories
problem: Saved places, friends, plans and memories are scattered across map and social apps; Anywhere combines them on one map that AI agents can read and edit.
product_category: Social map and personal location app

founders.name: Charly Delaroche
previous_startups: amo, maker of Bump (co-founder per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page: principal engineer at Life360, early Zenly employee who led the map effort, built a C++ map engine.

competitors.name: Mmotion
competitors.what: Location sharing friendship app competing with Snap Map

technical_complexity.rationale: Map rendering and sync are hard but the founder has built map engines before; agent access adds modest complexity.

defensibility.rationale: A social map can build network effects but starts from zero and competes with Snap Map, Instagram Map and Apple and Google maps.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Instagram added a Map feature recently per a search summary; no outcome for Anywhere yet.

market_need_then: Demand for social maps is unproven; one article questions whether they build durable businesses. Zenly was acquired by Snap, showing earlier appetite.

branding.name_origin: Not stated; Fenn is the AI assistant name inside the app
branding.domain_note: Hosted at anywhere.fenn.chat, a subdomain of the Fenn brand, not an exact anywhere.com.

identity.visual_style: Interactive miniature globe on landing page
identity.voice_and_tone: Warm, short, whimsical, tagline Your only map

brand_strength.rationale: Warm voice and globe are distinctive, but the name is generic with no external brand coverage.

outcome_analysis: Anywhere is a Fall 2026 company with no outcome yet. The founder has deep map and social location experience from Zenly, Bump and Life360, which is strong founder market fit. The category has a poor record for durable businesses and strong incumbents, so distribution is the key risk.
notes: A press article (RuntimeWire) names Marc McCole as a second cofounder; the YC page lists only Delaroche, so only he is recorded. No funding found. Prior employer details rely on the YC page.
